name: status_pool
description: Double HP and Double MP: the old and new flag bits, the base maxima doubled and capped (9999 and 999, or 99999 and 9999 with Break HP / MP Limit), the current HP and MP clamped, and the cases where nothing is touched.

function.signature: int apply_double_hp_mp(int id, Chr *chr, int newFlags)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function (the plain clamp helper runs for real too); nothing is replaced

notes: in.flags is the byte Chr+0x640 before the call, in.newFlags the third argument (negative = none), in.autoB the word Chr+0x6be; baseMax* are Chr+0x59c / 0x5a0 and are never written.
out holds the byte Chr+0x640 after the call, the maxima Chr+0x594 / 0x598 and HP / MP.
